tuner_timing.justification: Prioritizing exploration in early cycles to map the parameter space. Reducing latency-related parameters to their minimum to aggressively probe for lower latency.

The previous iteration with very low values for latency and granularity resulted in higher latency. Returning to values closer to the first iteration, which performed better, to explore that promising region further.

The previous best result (16.50) was achieved with wakeup_granularity_ns=4,000,000. Iteration 3 showed a degradation with 3,000,000, so we will slightly increase it to 3,500,000 to explore around the previous best region. Other parameters remain the same as they were part of the best performing configuration.

The best performance was achieved with latency_ns=24ms and min_granularity_ns=3ms. We will slightly adjust wakeup_granularity_ns to explore values between the best two configurations (16.50 and 17.38).

The best performing configurations cluster around latency_ns=24ms and min_granularity_ns=3ms. We will slightly adjust wakeup_granularity_ns to explore this promising region further, and keep other parameters stable.

The best performing configurations cluster around latency_ns=24ms and min_granularity_ns/wakeup_granularity_ns around 3ms. I will slightly adjust these to re-explore this promising region, keeping other parameters at their last tested values.

The best performing configurations are clustered around latency_ns=24,000,000 and min_granularity_ns=3,000,000. We will slightly increase wakeup_granularity_ns to explore a nearby region, while keeping other parameters stable to see if we can improve upon the current best latency.

The best configurations cluster around latency_ns=24,000,000 and min_granularity_ns=3,000,000. We will slightly increase wakeup_granularity_ns to explore this promising region further, while keeping other parameters stable.

The best performing configurations cluster around latency_ns=24ms, min_granularity_ns=3ms, wakeup_granularity_ns=3-4ms, and migration_cost_ns=0.5ms. We will explore slightly lower migration_cost_ns to see if it further reduces latency while keeping other parameters stable. The convergence flag remains false as there is still variability and potential for improvement.

The top performing configurations cluster around latency_ns=24M, min_granularity_ns=3M, and wakeup_granularity_ns=3-4M. We'll continue exploring this region, slightly increasing wakeup_granularity_ns to see if it offers further gains.

The best performing configuration (14.36) used min_granularity_ns and wakeup_granularity_ns around 2.5M. We will continue to explore around this value, slightly decreasing min_granularity_ns to see if further latency reduction is possible, and keep other parameters the same.

The best performing configuration (iter 54) had latency_ns, min_granularity_ns, and wakeup_granularity_ns set to 24ms, 2.5ms, and 2.5ms respectively. We will re-test this configuration to confirm its performance given the noisy nature of the measurements and the recent trials showing higher latency.
